heights.description: Ground heights in half levels, one digit per column (omitted: all 0).

stamps.description: Render hints (the engine ignores them): prefab stamps, room wall frames, music, light.

anchors.description: Named spots ('square.well') for schedules, scenes and authors.

regions.description: Named areas [x, y, w, h] ('far_bank') for scenes and goals.

regionProps.description: What a named area is beyond its cells (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.1): whose it is (`owner`), whether it is `private`.

law.description: The watch that keeps the law here (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.7).

appear.description: What appears on the map by itself (world-model.md §6.9): the ground's yield, creatures that come back.

zone.description: Peaceful (towns, camps: nothing comes out at night) or combat (default: zombies and bats come out after dark, nightspawn.ts).

scale.description: A step here lasts this many minutes (times its ground's `cost`): the overworld's scale. Without it, a step is a body's own pace.

site.description: Where the map lies on the overworld: the top left of its cell's block there (world-model.md §5.1). Its open edges lead to it.

backdrop.description: Background: a place made to fill the world, not played yet (no story, no one's errand) — held to the checks every map is, but none of a played map's (the engine ignores it).

strokes.description: The editor's brush strokes that drew it, with their seeds (the engine ignores them: the rows are the map).

opensWhen.description: A story fact that must hold for the way to be open (until then the tile is only ground): a way out the story opens.

on.description: The grounds it appears on (terrain ids); any ground one can stand on when absent.

max.description: At most this many on the map: those tagged `tag` if it is given, else those of its types.

every.description: Ticks between appearances (a multiple of the `appear` period).

ring.description: How far from the one at the keys, [near, far] cells (default: anywhere, not within two).

hours.description: When: hours [from, to) (past midnight when from > to), and weathers.

night.description: When: at night, however long the story's night has grown (World.isNight; instead of hours).

where.description: Which maps (for the world's own): by the map's zone and light.

tag.description: A tag what appears carries (counted by `max`).

temper.description: When it attacks those its factions are hostile to: always, after dark only, or only once provoked. Whoever strikes it becomes a foe, whatever its temper.

foes.description: Whoever struck it: attacked on sight.

leash.description: How far from where it lives (home, or its night roam) it will chase before it gives up (default 8).

detour.description: The way around an obstacle it is following, to the goal it was planned for.

noWay.description: A goal no way led to (one shut in a house): it does not look for a way there again until then.

night.description: Where it roams at night (creatures come out after dark); by day it keeps to `home`.

ai.description: A creature's behaviour (its home is where it appears), and statuses it appears with.

AppearDef.description: What appears by itself (world-model.md §6.9; Don't Starve's twigs and flint, Minecraft's mobs, the night's walkers): data only. Now and then one more of the weighted types appears on a free cell of the right ground, at the right distance from the one at the keys, at the right hours and weather, until `max` of them are on the map.

z.description: The storey (world-model.md §5.2): 0 the ground's, 1 the floor above it … (omitted: 0).

temper.description: When it attacks those its factions are hostile to: always, after dark only, or only once provoked. Whoever strikes it becomes a foe, whatever its temper.

foes.description: Whoever struck it: attacked on sight.

leash.description: How far from where it lives (home, or its night roam) it will chase before it gives up (default 8).

detour.description: The way around an obstacle it is following, to the goal it was planned for.

noWay.description: A goal no way led to (one shut in a house): it does not look for a way there again until then.

night.description: Where it roams at night (creatures come out after dark); by day it keeps to `home`.

ai.description: A creature's behaviour (its home is where it appears).

statuses.description: Statuses it appears with, for their default durations (a hen's laying).

Forage.description: An older chunk's appearance (MapData.forage): one type.

tags.description: Instance tags, added to the type's tags.

statuses.description: status id -> expiry tick (Infinity-like = -1 means no expiry)

statusBy.description: status id -> who gave it (the actor of the outcome that set it): its time events name them.

contents.description: Ordered contents of a container or an actor's inventory.

residentWork.description: A residence work order survives death when the actor becomes a body; its cargo stays physical.

combat.description: The actor's memory of its own blows and steps (combos, chains, windows its talents open): written only by its own act-making (combat.ts) and its own outcomes, never read by rules — like a cooldown. Anything others see (health, a bleed) is a prop or a status.

script.description: The story's script: where it stands (the scene playing) — its behaviour memory.

boss.description: An encounter's behaviour memory (its telegraph, its animation); its blows are acts.

frozenBy.description: Set while an undefined outcome involving this entity awaits a patch (design.md §5.11).

dropped.description: Items a rule dropped on the ground (a harvest, logs, loot): the player's magnet pulls them in.

slots.description: The player: inventory slots (design.md §5.3), each the stack key of what it holds; row 1 is the toolbar.

skillbar.description: The skill bar (the one at the keys): the active skills set in its six slots (Shift+1–6), by id.

selected.description: The player: the selected slot (what is held).

look.description: How an actor looks: a look record (its body, a part per slot and a colour per colour key; the map sprite, the portrait and the look's tags and words are all drawn from it, docs/looks.md), or the key of a whole drawn sheet in the client's catalogue (a figure no parts make: a skeleton, a statue).

from.description: The map whose file made it (a thing of that map's chunk, docs/continent.md §9): while it is as the file has it, the file is its record — a save keeps what differs, a map put away takes it along —, and once gone it stays gone.

Place.description: Where an entity is: on a tile, inside a container/inventory, or nowhere (destroyed).

person.description: A person's record (docs/game-design.md §5); crowd NPCs may have none.

override.description: A detour a rule ordered (`goto`): this anchor until the tick, whatever the schedule says.

resident.description: Where the person has moved to live (the society module's `moveIn`, a home ground's resident): this place and its days, over every schedule variant (a detour still goes first), until they move again.

memory.description: What the person remembers of talking: the lines said, the last one, the day last talked to (their own record).

fidelity.description: How much of the world's attention they have (docs/continent.md §9): `local` — one of the backdrop's people, who keeps to their own map (their days never leave it), is made with it and put away with it, and is left out of the hourly routing of the people who travel. Unset: a person of the story, kept and routed wherever they are.

from.description: Game hour window [from, to) in 0..24; may wrap past midnight.

uses.description: The thing the activity needs (the fire she tends, the cart he minds).

need.description: What `uses` must be for the activity to go on (the fire lit); else the person is blocked.

work.description: The work the activity is (world-model.md §6.10): real acts on what is about, tried in order.

type.description: Is-a match against the type hierarchy (prefix on slash paths): `actor`, `item/food`, `tile/grass`…

Selector.description: Selects the entity or tile filling a role. All given constraints must hold.

when.description: A condition on the worker (the host) the work waits for: carrying fewer than six logs.

WorkDef.description: A piece of work (world-model.md §6.10, D26): the act a person does, with the player's own acts, on the nearest thing that fits within `radius` of their anchor (a woodcutter's axe on a tree), with what they carry that fits `holding`.

Verb.description: What an actor does: the inputs, and the behaviour of people and creatures (the same acts).

stacks.description: Count the slots they take rather than the things: a slot holds STACK_MAX of one stack key.

adding.description: Count as if one more of this role's thing were among them (does the one at hand still fit).

Reader.description: What a condition may read: the event's roles, and the stewards every rule may read (the story, the world).

Bounds.description: Numeric bounds whose limits may be read from roles. A missing property fails the test.

Operand.description: A number, or a number read from a role's prop (scaled) or from the event's params.

once.description: said at most once to the player

LineDef.description: A line and the context it is for. Keys, most specific first (people.ts resolves them): topic:<id> · fact:<key> (the fact is truthy) · greeting:first · weather:<w> · hour:<morning|day|evening|night> · default — and when handed something: given:<type prefix> · given. Slots in the text: {player} {name} {friend:<id>} {fact:<key>} {item}.

ScheduleVariant.description: A schedule variant. Keys, most specific first: fact:<key> (the fact is truthy) · storm · rain · default.

said.description: keys (or texts) of once-only and topic lines already said

last.description: the last line said, not repeated next time

talked.description: the day they were last talked to

deeds.description: What they know was done (docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.4): seen or heard, newest last.

regard.description: What they think of others, by id (−100..100; missing: their start), and when each last changed (it fades back from there).

met.description: Whom they know by sight (met, talked to, seen close in daylight).

chatted.description: The day each was last talked to, by id (talking raises regard once a day).

afraid.description: Whom they fear for now (they saw them do violence): run from them until the tick.

toldFavourite.description: Whom they have told what they like best (their `favourite` prop, said in a chat): the gift panel says it from then on.

NpcMemory.description: What a person remembers (their own record): what they said, what they saw and heard, what they think of others.

by.description: Who did it, if they knew them.

desc.description: How the doer looked, when they did not know them (a hood hides the hair): matched later against who they see.

words.description: That look in words, for what they say.

against.description: Against whom: a person's id, or `household:<h>`.

thing.description: What it was done to or with (the thing taken).

what.description: The thing's name then (it may be gone since).

firsthand.description: Seen with their own eyes (else heard).

fine.description: The fine the watch would charge for it.

reported.description: Told to the watch; settled (given back, paid for, forgiven).

told.description: Whom they have told it to.

DeedMemory.description: A deed a person knows of: what was done, by whom (or how they looked), to whom, and how they know.

body.description: The body (`LookTable.bodies`): its frame on the map and its bust in the portrait.

parts.description: A part per slot (`LookTable.parts`; the slot is the part's own): hair, face, outfit, hat, beard, mark, glasses…

colors.description: A colour per colour key: `skin`, `hair`, `eyes`, and a part's own as `<slot>.<n>` (`outfit.1`); a colour of `LookTable.colors` by id, or `#rrggbb`. A key no colour is given for takes the part's default.

own.description: Changed in the world (`restyle`): the world's own design of this person no longer replaces it on load.

Look.description: A look (docs/looks.md): what a body is drawn from — the one record its map sprite, its portrait and its look's tags and words all come from, so they cannot disagree. Parts and colours are the ontology's (`Ontology.looks`); their pictures are the client's.

cells.description: Authorized planted cells; a replacement crop at the same cell remains within the order.

ResidentWorkOrder.description: A saved, explicitly authorized residence task and its still-recoverable physical cargo.

temper.description: When it attacks those its factions are hostile to: always, after dark only, or only once provoked. Whoever strikes it becomes a foe, whatever its temper.

foes.description: Whoever struck it: attacked on sight.

leash.description: How far from where it lives (home, or its night roam) it will chase before it gives up (default 8).

detour.description: The way around an obstacle it is following, to the goal it was planned for.

noWay.description: A goal no way led to (one shut in a house): it does not look for a way there again until then.

night.description: Where it roams at night (creatures come out after dark); by day it keeps to `home`.

fightTick.description: When it last fought: struck at an actor, was struck by one, or was chased by a hostile one (the `fighting` condition).

lastHurtBy.description: Who struck it last, and what they were (kept when they are gone): who felled it, when it falls.

retaliateUntil.description: Warrior: a Retaliation is ready until this tick (after taking a hit).

rampageStacks.description: Warrior: Rampage stacks, and when they lapse.

markTarget.description: Ranger: Hunter's Mark — ranged hits in a row on one target.

fleetUntil.description: Ranger: Fleet Archer's speed lasts until this tick.

spellHits.description: Mage: magic hits landed (every fourth echoes).

dodgeTick.description: Swiftness: the last dodge (Untouchable readies a critical from it), and blows pass by until this tick (Phantom Step, Phoenix).

slipUntil.description: Swiftness: Slipstream's speed after a dash lasts until this tick.

chain.description: Damage: Momentum — hits landed in a chain, and when the last one was.

adrenalineTick.description: Survival: Adrenaline — when it last came (once a minute; the rush itself is a status).

starHits.description: Relics (a Stigmatic piece's power): Starfall's hits toward the fifth, the gale's speed until, the Unfallen Wall's last turned blow.

hasteUntil.description: Active skills (actives.ts): Gale Step's speed, a War Cry's guard and strength, a Smoke Bomb's veil — until these ticks.

envenomHits.description: Envenom: so many more blows open a bleed.

rain.description: Arrow Rain: volleys still to fall on a 3×3 around (x, y), the next at tick `next`.

ironUntil.description: Iron Guard: blows taken much lighter, steps slower, until this tick. Hawk Eye: reach and criticals, until this tick.

defeats.description: Creatures it has felled (the talents that answer a defeat: actives.ts onDefeat), and casts made (Elemental Master).

line.description: the line waiting to be advanced (so a client that missed the say event can show it)

phase.description: The phase it has come to (it never goes back, healed).

opened.description: The phase whose opening skill it has taken up.

step.description: Its place in the phase's rotation.

winding.description: What the wind-up under way was taken up as: a phase's opening or a step of the rotation. A wind-up is behaviour memory and a save loses it; the director, finding this without one, gives the opening or the step back.

nextAt.description: Not before this tick does it take up the next.

skill.description: The skill it last took up (its id), and the clip it is drawn with.

BossState.description: An encounter's behaviour memory (the kits module's director): where it is in its fight.
